results.name: Modern Open-Concept Kitchen Stall
results.description: This 3D model showcases a modern open-concept kitchen design with an island and eco-friendly features. The kitchen is designed to maximize functionality while maintaining a minimalist and sleek aesthetic. The open-concept layout allows for seamless flow between the kitchen and living areas, making it perfect for entertaining guests. The island serves as a multifunctional workspace and storage solution, featuring built-in cabinets and drawers. The kitchen cabinets are designed with a contemporary style and are made from sustainable materials, adding to the eco-friendly nature of the design. The kitchen appliances are state-of-the-art and energy-efficient, further contributing to the environmentally-conscious design. The flooring is made of durable and sustainable materials, such as bamboo or cork, providing both style and practicality. The backsplash is made from recycled materials, adding a unique and eco-friendly touch to the design. The color scheme is a combination of neutral tones.

results.name: Red House
results.description:
Red House
A red-brick apartment building built in the 1960s.

The 45-square-meter American-style apartment centers on cozy practicality, blending classic elements with modern design. An open layout breaks spatial constraints, while the integrated living-dining-kitchen area enhances a sense of spaciousness, complemented by natural tones like soft grays and creamy whites to create a comfortable ambiance. Solid wood furniture and linen/cotton textiles convey rustic charm, with accents like wrought iron pendant lights and vintage-inspired artwork adding nostalgic American flair. Glass partitions and hidden storage maximize vertical space efficiency, while simplified moldings and distressed finishes balance historical character with compact living needs. Ideal for singles or couples, it crafts a functional yet romantic mini-haven embodying the essence of Americana.

https://bitsnote.com/sketchup/RedHouse.html

results.name: Kennedy House 14L, Forest Hills
results.description:
1160 ft² (108 square meters)

One of the most amenity rich buildings in Forest Hills, The Kennedy House offers 24-hour doorman / concierge service, children's playroom, rooftop pool, gym and community room on an expansive roof deck with 360 degree views of Forest Hills.

Welcome home to 14L at the Kennedy House, a large 2 bedroom 1 bathroom with open views of Forest Park. Gone are the parquet floors and replaced with hardwood floors throughout. Tons of closet space, 5 in total. A renovated kitchen with subway tile backsplash blends beautifully with the Corian countertops. A private balcony is large enough to host nice dinner with open views of Forest Park and more.

From fresh bread at La Boulangerie, Irish breakfast at Banter, to an abundant craft beer and whiskey selection over at Station House, Forest Hills is a bustling hub of food and entertainment with an array of transportation options.

Stop by your new home soon!

results.name: 333 Atwells 212
results.description:
Beautiful sunny condo located in the heart of Federal Hill overseeing the city of Providence. Convenience location allows you to walk everywhere including many unique restaurants and shops. Easy commute to high way, train station, and downtown. A spacious elevator, community meeting room, and gym are in the building. This modern 2 bedrooms 1.5 bathroom condo offers a spacious kitchen with granite countertops stainless steel appliances and tons of cabinet storage. In-unit laundry, central AC/heat, and top to floor windows throughout the living room are extra bonus. It also comes with one deeded assigned garage parking and one deeded assigned outdoor parking. There is an extra storage space in the basement. A true dream home for someone who is looking for an energetic city living style. Taxes $4581 reflect the owner-occupied rate. Water and Sewer are included in the condo fee.

results.name: Tea Kettle
results.description:
A weathered antique brass kettle with a wide bell-shaped body, arched strap handle, domed lid with turned knob, and a curved gooseneck spout. It's built as a game-ready prop with PBR textures.

The surface is the main feature. Brushed scratch marks run around the body, copper tones show through where the brass has worn, and dull green-gold patina collects in the creases and around the lid and base ring. The wear reads as a kettle that has spent decades over open fires and stoves.

Works well for period interiors, medieval and fantasy taverns, rustic kitchens, camping and survival scenes, cottage or farmhouse set dressing, and archviz still lifes. It can also serve as an interactive item in games.

Details

Separate-feeling parts: body, rolled base ring, lid and knob, spout, and swing handle
Hand-built wear: brushed scratches, patina, edge wear, subtle dents and grime
Textures: PBR metallic/roughness, resolution- 4096×4096
Created in Maya, textured in Substance Painter.
